name: scavio
description: Live web, social media, retailer and real estate data for ChatGPT and Codex: Google search, news, shopping and Maps; TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, X and LinkedIn; Amazon, Walmart, Target, Home Depot, eBay and Best Buy; Zillow, Redfin and Realtor.com; published company contact details; and the content of any public web page or site.

interface.longDescription:
Scavio brings live web, social media, retailer and real estate data into ChatGPT and Codex.

What you can do:
- Search Google and get the results page as structured data, including the AI Overview, related questions and local results. Find recent news, compare prices on Google Shopping, and find businesses, places and reviews on Google Maps.
- Social media: look up public TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, X and LinkedIn content, including posts, videos, comments, creators, hashtags, communities, video transcripts and LinkedIn job listings.
- Retailers: search products and read prices, ratings, reviews, sellers and store stock on Amazon, Walmart, Target, Home Depot, eBay (including sold listings) and Best Buy.
- Real estate: search homes for sale, for rent and recently sold on Zillow, Redfin and Realtor.com, with property details, price and tax history, value estimates, market stats and agents.
- Look up a company's published emails, phone numbers and social profiles from its own website.
- Read any public web page, list the pages of a site, or read many pages at once.

Who it is for: anyone researching a topic, a market, a product, a creator, a property or a list of local businesses who needs current information with links to the sources.

How it works: sign in with your Scavio account when you connect. Requests run on that account.

Limitations: Scavio reads public content only. It cannot sign in to other websites, read private accounts or messages, post, or buy anything. Site crawls respect robots.txt, and crawl and batch results stay available for 3 days.
capabilities: Search Google, news, shopping and Maps
Look up public TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, X and LinkedIn content
Compare products, prices and reviews at Amazon, Walmart, Target, Home Depot, eBay and Best Buy
Search homes, property details and market stats on Zillow, Redfin and Realtor.com
defaultPrompt: Find the top TikTok videos about air fryer recipes this week and summarize what they have in common.
Compare the price and rating of the Ninja AF101 air fryer on Amazon and Walmart.
Show three-bedroom homes for sale in Austin, TX under $500,000 on Zillow.

positive.prompt: Search Google for the best project management tools for small teams and list the top five results with links.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_google once and lists five organic results, each with its title and link, taken from the returned results page.

positive.prompt: Find recent news about electric vehicle battery recycling and list five articles with their source and date.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls google_news and lists five articles with title, publisher, date and link from the returned results.

positive.prompt: Find highly rated coffee shops in Austin, Texas on Google Maps, list five with rating and address, then show three reviews for the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls google_maps_search, lists five places with rating and address, then calls google_maps_reviews with the first place's place_id and shows three of its reviews.

positive.prompt: Read https://www.python.org/about/ and summarize what it says in three bullet points.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls extract_url on the given URL and summarizes the page content in three bullet points without adding facts that are not on the page.

positive.prompt: What contact email and social profiles does Epoch Coffee publish on its website epochcoffee.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls company_enrich with the website and reports the email address and social profile links the company publishes, with its contact page link.

positive.prompt: Search TikTok for videos about sourdough starter tips and list five with the creator and view count.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_tiktok_videos and lists five videos with caption, creator and view count from the returned results.

positive.prompt: Search Amazon for the Kindle Paperwhite and tell me the current price and rating of the top result.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_amazon and reports the top result's title, price and rating from the returned data, with its link.

positive.prompt: Find three-bedroom homes for sale in Austin, TX under $500,000 on Zillow and list five with price and address.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_zillow for Austin, TX with the bedroom and price filters and lists five listings with price, address and link from the returned results.

review.commerce_description: Scavio does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT or Codex. It returns public web data, including product prices, for information only.

publication.release_notes: Adds social media, retailer and real estate data: TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, X and LinkedIn; Amazon, Walmart, Target, Home Depot, eBay and Best Buy; Zillow, Redfin and Realtor.com, with a skill for each platform.
